changelog: Fixed: new data from hijri.iiuc.net now shows up in the app. Saving anchors in Settings no longer stops online syncing.
Manual edits now only protect the months you changed. All other months keep updating from online.
New sync indicator in the popup and tray tooltip: synced, synced with custom data, or not synced, with the last sync time.
New Refresh now button in the popup to sync instantly.
Settings: new Source column shows whether each month is Online or Manual. A ⚠ flag and a Use online button appear when online has a different date than the one you set.
Settings: new Sync fully button to discard all manual edits and take everything from online.
Raw JSON tab now shows the current combined data, and months you change become manual.
Your existing saved anchors are converted automatically: months that match online go back to following online.
The app version is now shown in the popup, Settings and tray menu.
New automatic update check, with View changelog and Update now.
